item.text: {"case_id":"SPR00085","decision":"candidate","candidate_ranking":["C19","C21","C24"],"selected_candidate_label":"C19","confidence":0.97,"relationship_type":"both","rationale":"C19 plausibly supplied a concrete drafting template. Both are presidential letters appointing a named individual as Special Assistant to the President for international or foreign-economic work, defining the role through advice and assistance concerning programs spanning multiple departments and agencies, using the formula “I shall look to you,” and providing participation in high-level coordinating bodies. C21 is also a strong structural analogue, while C24 shares the addressee and substantive international-development setting but not the same appointment structure.","shared_material":[{"child_excerpt":"I hereby appoint you as Special Assistant to the President.","parent_excerpt":"Effective immediately I am designating you as Special Assistant to the President","explanation":"The central operative act is expressed in closely parallel appointment language."},{"child_excerpt":"I shall look to you for advice and assistance in the development of increased understanding and cooperation among all peoples.","parent_excerpt":"to assist and advise me in accomplishing an orderly development of foreign economic policies and programs","explanation":"Both assign the Special Assistant an advisory and developmental role in international affairs."},{"child_excerpt":"I shall also look to you for assistance in reviewing and developing methods and programs by which the various Departments and agencies of the government may effectively contribute","parent_excerpt":"I shall look to you to provide for the anticipation of problems and issues, ensure advance preparation, analyze information ... and determine the primary responsibilities of the executive agencies","explanation":"Both use the distinctive “I shall look to you” formula to charge the appointee with reviewing or developing coordinated work across executive agencies."},{"child_excerpt":"You are requested to attend the meetings of the Cabinet, the National Security Council, the Council on Foreign Economic Policy, and the Operations Coordinating Board.","parent_excerpt":"The achievement of such integration will be furthered by your attendance at such meetings of those organizations as you consider necessary","explanation":"Both conclude the assignment by connecting the Special Assistant to high-level councils and interagency coordinating bodies through meeting attendance."}]}
